headline: Executive order on coordinating federal transportation programs that help people reach human services.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with coordinating transportation services connected to federal human service programs. Such programs can help people get to places like medical visits, jobs, or social services. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies, and deadlines in the order cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that fund or run human service transportation
who_it_affects.how: The title suggests these agencies would be expected to coordinate their transportation efforts.

who_it_affects.group: People who rely on transportation provided through federal human service programs
who_it_affects.how: The services they use may be affected by changes in how these programs are coordinated.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 24, 2004; the material provided does not give a separate effective date.
